pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions exhibit a polygonal tessellation with high edge angularity on the flank, transitioning to slightly more rounded geometries on the lower neck. Edge transitions show sharp pixel gradients between the dark interior and the light border regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological network with a high degree of connectivity. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, creating a well-defined web structure.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated profile along the dorsal ridge. The 1D contour against the background is jagged, with individual hair clusters contributing to a non-uniform silhouette.
